requirements.R_CLI: Unknown flags/commands and missing --input exit 2 before WAL mutation.
requirements.R_RESET: --reset-output clears out/ only and does not truncate WAL.
requirements.R_INSPECT: inspect and empty-check rewrite health without recover, apply, WAL append, heap/index/replica mutation, or epoch bump.
requirements.R_COMMIT: Valid commits install committed-visible heap rows and rewrite health.
requirements.R_UNIQUE: Duplicate visible sku_code is UNIQUE_CONFLICT, WAL ABORT, and is not installed.
requirements.R_HOLD: Hold qty exceeding on-hand is HOLD_QTY.
requirements.R_WRITESET: One txn overlay allows parent sku and child offer together.
requirements.R_RECOVER: Recover skips uncommitted WAL and does not bump replica epoch.
requirements.R_CDC: Decode reads committed WAL lsns and omits crash inserts and includes update before images.
requirements.R_APPLY: Apply is LSN monotonic, epoch-fenced, FK-ordered, and reports integer fields.
requirements.R_INDEX: Secondary indexes match committed-visible heap after commit and recover.
requirements.R_HEALTH: Health report uses the contracted schema and epoch fields; decode/apply rewrite health.
requirements.R_CHECKPOINT: checkpoint stores durable WAL lsn and does not change replica epoch.
requirements.R_WAREHOUSE: Warehouse dump bytes stay in place.
requirements.R_CONTRACT: catalogctl remains the Go operator binary and the catalog contract stays binding.
